before.login_page_render: PublicOnly rendered an infinite spinner while AuthProvider waited for /auth/me.
before.session_bootstrap: AuthProvider.refresh() called currentUserRequest() with no frontend timeout.
blocking_points: AuthGuard/PublicOnly had no 5s hard loading cap.

session_bootstrap.fallback: clear auth state and render login path instead of hanging

login_submit_chain: set auth state from login response

api_safety_layer.retry_scope: safe idempotent methods only; aborts/timeouts are not retried

success_criteria_mapping.login_under_2s_complete: Frontend no longer adds a second /auth/me call after successful /auth/login; live latency depends on backend /auth/login response time.
success_criteria_mapping.auth_me_never_blocks_ui: /auth/me is bounded by apiRequest 5000ms timeout and AuthProvider fallback.
success_criteria_mapping.no_infinite_loading_spinner: PublicOnly and AuthGuard both have 5000ms loading caps.
success_criteria_mapping.dashboard_reachable_after_login: LoginForm redirects to /dashboard immediately after AuthProvider.login resolves from /auth/login.
success_criteria_mapping.no_double_auth_validation: AuthProvider.login removed the post-login currentUserRequest/sessionCheckRequest call.
